item: R101 follow-up: Observatory breadth and bulletin country coverage leave quarantined articles out
summary: Open-on-main row 40. distinct_sources (every galaxy's and group's breadth, the Observatory's radius) counted the outlet of a quarantined page as one more independent voice, and the bulletin's country coverage counted its articles and terms; both now take quarantine_scope.not_quarantined, as do the rising-galaxy card's outlet count, active-outlet denominator and article drill (its share and growth already did, so one card read two scopes) and the bulletin's earliest-channel section (a quarantined page could be credited as first to carry a concept); four tests, red on main. Row 47 folded in: every reader that left a salvage stand-in out of a per-source or per-article count from the mentions now leaves a quarantined article out beside it (story_propagation outlet floor, first sightings and drill; concentration flooded and buried topics; supply_chain_ripple series, daily totals, independence gate and drill; source_topics; the AI source-tag evidence floor and terms; supply_chain_ripple's candidate preselection, which had neither gate, so a topic carried by such pages could take a slot), and the bulletin's topic table (per-tag articles, total and tagged mentions) leaves quarantined articles out too; pinned by a per-module twin guard and behaviour tests red on main. Row 37 (widening ix_mention_date_keyword with article_id) closed as measured and not worth it: 4.8 s and 300 MB of sort memory to build on 5M synthetic mentions (about 12 s and 700 MB projected at 12M, more encrypted) for about 0.2 s per 37-day day-count rebuild; reopens only if a field store shows day counts slow.
